headlines.text: Back on this day in 2021, Tony Nese made their AEW debut against Sammy Guevara, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.23 ? a well-worked match. Nese's official AEW in-ring debut, targeting the champion's taped-up ribs from a previous street fight ? a competitive title challenge that saw Nese nearly steal the win with a 450 splash before Guevara survived with the GTH.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley met in a Continental Classic League Match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 7.92 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
